candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, which propagates as ReadTimeout to order and 502 on gateway /v1/checkout and /v1/orders.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, cascading to 503 reservations, ReadTimeout on order, and 502 checkout/orders. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics for inventory's Redis dependency
Inventory service logs around the timeout window
